product.name: Monoprice Mini DisplayPort 1.2a / Thunderbolt to VGA Active Adapter Black
product.description: Connect your Mini DisplayPort® or Thunderbolt™ equipped PC or Mac® to a VGA monitor using this Mini DisplayPort 1.2a / Thunderbolt to VGA Active Adapter from Monoprice™!This adapter is designed to allow you to connect a VGA monitor to a Mini DisplayPort or Thunderbolt video output. It conforms to the DisplayPort 1.2a standard and supports resolutions up to 1920x1080p @60Hz. Being an active adapter, it is fully compatible with the AMD® Eyefinity and nVidia® Surround™ multidisplay modes.It features a true 6" cable length with polycarbonate connector heads. The VGA end has panel screw holes, so you can secure the cable to the connector. The MDP connector head measures about 14 x 16 x 24 mm. The VGA connector head measures about 20 x 42 x 47 mm.Features: Conforms to DisplayPort® 1.2a standardConnects to both Mini DisplayPort and Thunderbolt™ video outputsSupports VGA resolutions up to 1920x1080p @60HzACTIVE adapter is compatible with nVidia® Surround™ and AMD® Eyefinity multidisplay modes Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
